g.ns2:text: \\noindent$ub=1\\\\\nlb=0\\\\\n0.5 \\nless 0 \\text{, then }h2 \\text{ is active}\\\\\n0 \\nless 0 \\text{, then }h2 \\text{ is active, but is suppressed by } h2$
\\noindent$ub=0\\\\\nlb=-1\\\\\n0.5 > 0 \\text{, then }h1\\text{ is not active}\\\\\n0 \\ngtr 0 \\text{, then } h1 \\text{ is active. Must also suppress } h2$

\\noindent bias is 1 and weight is -1\\\\\n$h_5=h_4\\cdot w_1+b\\cdot w_2\\\\\nh_5=h_4\\cdot 1 + 1\\cdot-1 \\\\\nh_5=h_4-1\\\\\nlb=0\\text{, if } h_5 \\geq 0 \\text{ then } h_5 \\text{ is active, else } h_5 \\text{ is not active}\n$
set weights to 0 and leave bias as 1
\\noindent$ub=1\\\\\nlb=0.5\\\\\n0.5 \\nless 0.5 \\text{, then }h2 \\text{ is active}\\\\\n0 < 0.5 \\text{, then }h2 \\text{ is not active }$
\\noindent$ub=1\\\\\nlb=0\\\\\n0.5 \\ngtr 1 \\text{, then }h1\\text{ is active}\\\\\n0 \\ngtr 1 \\text{, then } h1 \\text{ is active}$

\\noindent bias is 1 and weight is 1\\\\\n$h_5=h_4\\cdot w_1+b\\cdot w_2\\\\\nh_5=h_4\\cdot 1 + 1\\cdot 1 \\\\\nh_5=h_4+1\\\\\nlb=-1\\text{, if } h_5 \\geq 0 \\text{ then } h_5 \\text{ is active, else } h_5 \\text{ is not active}\n$
set weights to 0 and leave bias as 1

\\begin{adjustwidth}{0cm}{7cm}\nNeurons update to make the outgoing neurons active? If so the neurons can push the updates to propagate their signals in an unbalanced network that kills their signal. \n\\end{adjustwidth}
